q1.question: How many main ways did the Prophet transmit the Quran to his community?
q1.a4: 4 ways: writing, oral, gesture, and dream

q2.question: Which of the following represents the WRITTEN method of transmitting the Quran?
q2.a2: Recording the revealed text in writing

q3.question: The ORAL method of transmitting the Quran refers to...

q4.question: Who played the most prominent role in recording the revelation directly during the Prophet's lifetime?
q4.a4: Scribes of revelation such as Zaid ibn Thabit

q5.question: What was the purpose of having two methods (written and oral) for transmitting the Quran?
q5.a1: To ensure the Quran is preserved and delivered accurately to future generations
q5.a3: To facilitate translation to other languages

q1.question: What does the term mutawatir mean?
q1.a1: Narration by a single, highly trusted person
q1.a2: Narration by a very large number of narrators at every generation
q1.a3: Narration that exists only in one era

q2.question: Why is it considered impossible for a mutawatir narration to be falsified?
q2.a1: Because the number of narrators is so large and widespread that it is inconceivable for them to conspire
q2.a2: Because only certain people were allowed to narrate
q2.a3: Because it was documented in writing from the very beginning
q2.a4: Because it was supervised by the government

q3.question: The Quran reaching us through the path of mutawatir means...
q3.a1: Through a single very strong chain of narration
q3.a2: Through a select few individuals only
q3.a3: Through millions of narrators in every generation keeping it perfectly preserved
q3.a4: Through translation from its original language

q4.question: In the definition of mutawatir, what does "at every generation" mean?
q4.a4: From the beginning of the chain to its end, passing through every generation without interruption

q5.question: Besides orally, the Quran also reached us via mutawatir through...
q5.a2: The Mushaf written and distributed widely

q1.question: Who first transmitted the Quranic revelation into the heart of Prophet Muhammad?

q2.question: How did the companions verify that their recitation was correct?
q2.a1: They submitted their memorization before the Prophet for correction
q2.a2: They compared it to the Prophet's written notes
q2.a4: They sought approval from scholars of the time

q3.question: What did Angel Jibril transmit along with the Quran to the Prophet?
q3.a2: The wording, meaning, and the complete manner of its pronunciation

q4.question: The generation after the companions (Tabi'in) learned the Quran by...
q4.a3: Teaching and transmitting to the next generation in the exact same method
q4.a4: From audio recordings of the companions

q5.question: The chain of Quranic teaching from the Prophet to our time is...
q5.a4: Continuous and unbroken to this day

q2.question: During the first phase of codification, who was responsible for recording the revelation?
q2.a1: The scribes of revelation during the Prophet's lifetime, including Zaid ibn Thabit

q4.question: Caliph Uthman's role in the codification of the Quran was to...
q4.a2: Send standardized Mushafs to various regions accompanied by a qari
q4.a3: Translate the Quran into Qurayshi Arabic
q4.a4: Destroy all previous copies without replacement
